## Data honesty

<!-- RiskSense tells people about danger, so this section is required when the
     change touches events, sources, alerts or emergency data. -->

- [ ] This change does not invent events, coordinates, severity, statuses or
      emergency instructions.
- [ ] Satellite detections are still labelled as detections, not confirmed
      incidents.
- [ ] Ordinary forecasts are not presented as emergency warnings.
- [ ] Emergency numbers added or changed are verified against an official
      government source, which is linked below.
- [ ] Uncertainty and data freshness are still communicated where relevant.
